podcast.body: The title track from Matthew Sweet's 1991 album "Girlfriend" is described as the "just the song Matthew had been looking for" and a "fantastic PowerPop" example. This song was crucial in boosting his career's traction, positioning him as a notable figure in the 90s alt-rock scene that explored Powerpop sounds. "The title track was just the song Matthew had been looking for. Fantastic PowerPop from 1991, Matthew Sweet and Girlfriend."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
